tutorial.title: Tutorial
tutorial.subtitle: A training battle against the computer. At first the guide shows each move, step by step; then it is up to you: win the match to complete the tutorial.
tutorial.teamText: In training the team is already built, the opponent is always the same and the computer goes easy on you. Afterwards you pick your own five.

goal.title: Goal
goal.text: Each side brings 5 characters. Whoever takes down the whole other team wins.

turns.title: Turns
turns.text: Each turn every character acts once, from fastest to slowest.

energy.title: Energy
energy.text: The team shares one energy pool: 3 on the first turn and 1 more each turn, up to 10. Leftover energy does not carry over.

skills.title: Skills
skills.text: Every character has a free attack and stronger skills that cost energy.

passives.title: Passives
passives.text: Every character has a passive skill. Nobody has to use it: it makes their strikes stronger or acts on its own at the start of their turn.

effects.title: Effects
effects.text: Some skills leave effects for a few turns: burn, poison, stun, shield and changes to attack, defense and speed.

berserk.title: Berserk
berserk.text: From turn 9 on, the damage of every skill grows 50% each turn, for both teams.

tutorial.idle: Keep playing: win the match to complete the tutorial.
tutorial.done: Tutorial complete! Quick matches, the campaign and multiplayer are unlocked. Build your own team against the computer or invite someone to play.

do.skill: Click the {{skill}} skill, in the skills panel.
do.target: Now click the target marked "Click here": {{target}}, in the arena.
do.confirm: {{skill}} needs no target: it hits everyone marked at once. Confirm with the "{{button}}" button.

tutorial.watch: The computer is playing for the enemy. Follow it in the arena: the guide comes back on your turn.
tutorial.freeTitle: Now it is up to you
tutorial.free: Now that you have learned the basics of the game, win the match to complete the tutorial. Every skill and every target is unlocked. One last rule: from turn 9 on, Berserk starts and both teams deal more damage every turn.
tutorial.lost: You did not win the training battle, so the tutorial does not count as done yet. Redo the tutorial and win to unlock the other matches.
tutorial.followGuide: Follow the guide: it shows what to click now.

welcome.title: Welcome to training
welcome.text: Your team is on the left and the enemy is on the right. Whoever knocks down all five characters on the other side wins. At first the guide shows each move, step by step: just follow along.

queue.title: Turn order
queue.text: The queue at the top shows who acts this turn, from fastest to slowest. Each character acts once per turn. Bárbaro is the fastest of all, so he goes first.

energy.title: Energy
energy.text: The whole team shares the same energy: 3 on the first turn and 1 more each turn, up to 10. Whatever is left at the end of a turn does not carry over.

skills.title: Skills
skills.text: It is Bárbaro's turn. Each skill shows its energy cost, what it does and its base damage or healing. Skills tagged Passive are not clicked: they work on their own.

basicAttack.title: Basic attack
basicAttack.text: Every character has a free attack that can always be used. Let us start with it: Bárbaro will hit Banshee with {{skill}}.

damage.title: Damage
damage.text: The number that popped up was the damage, and the bar under each character is their health. Whoever reaches 0 health falls.

enemyTurn.title: The enemy's turn
enemyTurn.text: Between your moves, the computer plays for the enemy, in queue order. Espadachim struck your Cavaleiro three times in a row, and he lost a lot of health.

heal.title: Support skill
heal.text: It is Sacerdote's turn. {{skill}} costs 1 energy and is for your team: its targets are your allies, not the enemies. Let us heal Cavaleiro.

passive.title: Passive
passive.text: Look at Arqueiro's last skill, tagged Passive. It is not clicked: it works on its own whenever its condition happens. Every character has one.

eagleEye.title: Eagle Eye
eagleEye.text: Arqueiro's passive deals 50% more damage to anyone above 70% health, and Banshee still is. Even his free attack hits hard now.

status.title: Effects
status.text: The badges under a character are effects that last a few turns. The arrow left Banshee with lowered defense. The number on the badge is how many turns are left; hover over it to see what it does.

fireball.title: Burn
fireball.text: {{skill}} costs 1 energy, deals high damage and sets the target on fire for 2 turns: the burn keeps taking their health. Let us burn Vampiro.

area.title: Area attack
area.text: There is 1 energy left, enough for {{skill}}. This skill needs no target: it hits every enemy at once, lowers their attack and taunts them for 2 turns. While taunted, their single-target attacks can only aim at Cavaleiro, who can take it.

newTurn.title: New turn
newTurn.text: Everyone has acted, so turn 2 has started. Energy is full again, now with 4, and the queue was rebuilt by speed.

speed.title: Speed
speed.text: Bárbaro is no longer first in the queue: Dríade's passive hit him and slowed him down. Speed decides the order, so changing speed changes who acts first.

blessing.title: Support for the whole team
blessing.text: {{skill}} costs 2 energy and needs no target: it affects every ally at once. For 2 turns they are faster and have more attack.

slow.title: Slowing the enemy
slow.text: {{skill}} costs 1 energy, deals damage and lowers the target's speed for 2 turns. Slowed, Banshee will act after your team.

stun.title: Stun
stun.text: {{skill}} costs 1 energy and has a chance to stun: a stunned character loses their next turn. Let us aim at Espadachim, the enemy who hit your team the hardest.

stunned.title: Stunned
stunned.text: It worked: Espadachim is stunned and will lose his next turn. See the badge under him.

noEnergy.title: Out of energy
noEnergy.text: This turn's energy is gone, so the skills that cost energy are greyed out. The free attack is still available, and next turn your energy is full again.

combustion.title: Combustion
combustion.text: Piromante's passive deals 40% more damage to anyone burning or with lowered defense. Banshee has lowered defense and little health left: {{skill}} should take her down.

defeated.title: Character defeated
defeated.text: Banshee reached 0 health and fell: she leaves the queue for good. The battle ends when one team has no one left standing. Last guided move: Cavaleiro attacks Vampiro.

berserk.title: Berserk
berserk.text: From turn 9 on, the damage of every skill grows 50% each turn, for both teams. That keeps a battle from lasting forever.

singlePlayer.title: Single Player
singlePlayer.subtitle: Play against the AI: start with the tutorial, play a quick match or push through the campaign, stage by stage. The collection has every character.
singlePlayer.quickLead: Pick the AI level and build your team in a draft against it: you take turns, one character at a time. The arena is random.
singlePlayer.collectionLead: All {{count}} characters in the game. Hover over a card (or tap the corner button) to see its skills.

hint.easy: Spends energy once per turn and spreads its hits around.
hint.normal: Plays the usual way: heals, cleanses and finishes off the wounded.
hint.hard: Thinks through each move before acting and focuses damage where it matters most.

muralha.name: The Wall Road
muralha.story: A band of raiders has closed the road along the wall. They are warriors and marksmen, and none of them heals: bring them down before the Barbarian’s axe does the damage.

floresta.name: The Night Forest
floresta.story: In the forest, the creatures of the night are waiting. The Succubus puts your team to sleep, the Vampire drinks the life it takes and the Necromancer raises the dead. Bring someone who can cleanse.

campaign.locked: Locked. Beat stage {{stage}} to unlock it.
campaign.pickStage: Choose an unlocked stage above to build your team.
campaign.draftText: Stage {{stage}}: you take turns picking, with no bans, and the AI takes the stage team. Winning on any level opens the next stage.

tutorialGate.welcomeTitle: Start here: the tutorial is required
tutorialGate.welcomeText: Before your first match, you play a guided training battle. It shows you, right on the battlefield, everything you will use in every other match, and the computer goes easy on you while you learn.

learn.screen: Reading the battlefield: the turn order, everyone’s health and the active effects.
learn.energy: Spending the team’s energy, which is shared by every character.
learn.skills: When to use the basic attack and when to save energy for a strong skill.
learn.effects: What burn, poison, stun, shields and the other effects do.

tutorialGate.welcomeNote: Win the training battle to unlock the rest of the game. If you lose or give up, just redo the tutorial.
tutorialGate.lockedText: This match unlocks once you win the training battle. It only takes a few minutes, and it teaches what you will need here.
tutorialGate.lockedTab: locked until you play the tutorial
